data.value: [ VISUAL STUDIO DATA TOOLS ] 1. TableAdapter Wizard- generates SQL queries (like Fill or GetData()) to load database records into your application's DataTable. 2. The Query Builder- interface used to construct complex SQL queries. It consists of four sections: • Diagram Pane (shows tables) • Grid/Criteria Pane (spreadsheet view of selected columns) • SQL Pane (the actual SQL code) • Results Pane (data returned by the query) 3. ADO.NET Command An object that executes SQL commands (SELECT, INSERT, UPDATE, DELETE) directly against the database. 4. ADO.NET DataReader A high-performance object that reads data in a sequential, forward-only stream, used for quickly traversing database records.
